qa.rag_mode_desc: Combines knowledge base retrieval with large language model reasoning for more accurate answers. The system first retrieves relevant knowledge from terminology and SQL example libraries, then uses the LLM to generate SQL and charts.
qa.llm_mode_desc: Directly uses the large language model's reasoning capabilities to generate answers. Suitable for simple queries or scenarios where the knowledge base lacks relevant information.
qa.rag_retrieval_explanation: The system performs semantic retrieval in the semi-structured knowledge base to recall relevant field descriptions and business explanations, while loading administrator-configured terminology and SQL examples as context for more accurate responses.
qa.rag_retrieval_explanation_analysis: The system retrieves relevant knowledge from the semi-structured knowledge base and loads business terminology and SQL examples to help the LLM understand business concepts and generate professional data analysis.
qa.rag_retrieval_explanation_predict: The system retrieves relevant knowledge from the semi-structured knowledge base and loads business terminology and SQL examples to help the LLM understand prediction methods and generate accurate predictions.
qa.searching_knowledge_base: Searching knowledge base for relevant information
qa.using_rag_knowledge: Applying retrieved knowledge to generate SQL
qa.rag_knowledge_application_desc: The retrieved terminologies, SQL examples, and prompts above will be injected into the LLM's context to help the model better understand business requirements and generate correct SQL statements.
qa.flow_step1_desc: System retrieves relevant knowledge from terminology and SQL example databases based on user question
qa.flow_step2_desc: Retrieved knowledge is formatted into structured XML format for LLM understanding
qa.flow_step3_desc: Formatted knowledge is injected into the LLM's system prompt as contextual information
qa.flow_step3_highlight: Key: Knowledge is injected into prompt template via {terminologies} and {data_training} placeholders
qa.flow_step4_desc: LLM generates SQL queries that comply with business rules based on injected knowledge and user question
qa.technical_explanation_text: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant knowledge through vector similarity and injects it as context into the LLM prompt. This ensures the LLM can understand business terminology and reference historical examples when generating SQL, improving quality and accuracy.

tutorial.title: ChatBI Tutorial
tutorial.subtitle: Get started with business intelligent analysis in 5 minutes
tutorial.guide_desc: Learn about system features and usage
tutorial.reset_desc: Reset tutorial and view guide again

step1.title: Model Configuration
step1.desc: Connect your AI model to start intelligent analysis
step1.tip: ChatBI supports DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Qwen and other mainstream LLMs, switch flexibly as needed.

detail1.title: Enter Model Configuration
detail1.desc: Click 'Model Configuration' in the left menu

detail2.title: Add Model
detail2.desc: Click 'Add Model', select provider and enter API Key

detail3.title: Set as Default
detail3.desc: Set frequently used model as default for priority use

step2.title: Data Connections
step2.desc: Connect your database or upload data files
step2.tip: Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle databases, also Excel/CSV and PDF file upload.

detail1.title: Create Data Source
detail1.desc: Click 'Data Connections' → 'New Data Source' in left menu

detail2.title: Configure Connection
detail2.desc: Select database type, enter host, port, username, password

detail3.title: Select Tables
detail3.desc: After successful connection test, select tables to analyze

step3.title: RAG Knowledge Base
step3.desc: Configure RAG knowledge base to improve Q&A accuracy
step3.tip: RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) is the core technology, enhancing AI understanding through terminology and SQL examples.

detail1.title: Enter RAG Knowledge Base
detail1.desc: Click 'RAG Knowledge Base' in the left menu to enter configuration

detail2.title: Add Terminology
detail2.desc: Add business terms, synonyms and descriptions in 'Terminology'

detail3.title: Add SQL Examples
detail3.desc: Add common questions and corresponding SQL statements in 'SQL Examples'

step4.title: Data Q&A
step4.desc: Ask questions in natural language, get data insights
step4.tip: ChatBI automatically uses RAG technology to retrieve terminology and SQL examples, improving Q&A accuracy. You can see the 'RAG Enhanced' tag showing the retrieval process in the dialogue.

detail1.title: Start Dialogue
detail1.desc: Click 'Data Q&A' in left menu, select data source to start

detail2.title: View RAG Thinking Process
detail2.desc: Click the 'RAG Enhanced' button to see how the system retrieves knowledge, generates SQL, and executes queries

detail3.title: Data Analysis & Prediction
detail3.desc: Perform 'Data Analysis' or 'Data Prediction' on query results for deeper insights

step5.title: Dashboard
step5.desc: Save analysis results to Dashboard for centralized business data views
step5.tip: Dashboard supports multiple chart types. Use Edit Layout to enter canvas editor for drag-and-drop arrangement, perfect for data reports.

detail1.title: Add to Dashboard
detail1.desc: Click 'Add to Dashboard' in Q&A results

detail2.title: Manage Dashboard
detail2.desc: Click 'Dashboard' in left menu to view charts and AI AI business summary

detail3.title: Edit & Export
detail3.desc: Use 'Edit Layout' to enter canvas editor for chart arrangement, export as image

thinking.title: Thinking Process
thinking.rv_reason_no_results: No results found, expanded retrieval triggered
thinking.rv_reason_low_quality: Low quality results, supplementary retrieval triggered
thinking.rv_quality_sufficient: Quality sufficient, no second retrieval needed
thinking.prompt_not_configured: No custom prompts configured for this scenario. LLM uses default behavior. Add prompts in System → Custom Prompts.
thinking.rag_pipeline_step1_desc: Retrieve relevant content from external knowledge base
thinking.rag_pipeline_step2_desc: Inject retrieved results into prompt context
thinking.rag_pipeline_step3_desc: LLM generates answer based on augmented context
thinking.stage_error_default: An error occurred during this stage
thinking.rag_disabled_hint: RAG mode is off, using pure LLM reasoning
thinking.rag_no_results: RAG is enabled but no relevant knowledge found
thinking.smart_output_explanation: Intelligently select the optimal visualization based on SQL result data characteristics
thinking.step1_process: Intent recognition + Query rewrite + Reference resolution
thinking.step2_process: Embedding vectorization → Multi-path recall → Intelligent reranking
thinking.step5_process: Security check → DB connection → Execute query
thinking.step6_process: Smart output decision → Chart type matching → LLM ECharts config generation
thinking.step7_input_analysis: Query results + Field definitions + Business terminology
thinking.step7_process_analysis: Data quality annotation → Business semantic understanding → Insight generation
thinking.step7_input_prediction: Historical data + Field definitions + Business terminology
thinking.step7_process_prediction: Trend analysis → Time series prediction → Confidence evaluation
thinking.compression_not_needed: Context within token budget, no compression needed
thinking.dialogue_context_injected: Dialogue context injected into LLM prompt
thinking.retrieval_method_embedding: Retrieval: Query → Embedding vectorization → pgvector cosine similarity search → percentage = semantic similarity between query and chunk
thinking.retrieval_method_table_embedding: Retrieval: Query → Embedding vectorization → Cosine similarity with each table's Schema vector → Select Top-K most relevant tables
thinking.retrieval_method_terminology: Retrieval: ① Keyword match (ILIKE exact match, hit = 100%) ② Vector semantic search (Embedding similarity match)
thinking.retrieval_method_sql_examples: 3-channel hybrid retrieval: ① ILIKE substring match (keyword exact hit) ② Token-level fuzzy match (split long sentences into tokens) ③ Vector semantic search (Embedding cosine similarity)
thinking.compression_within_budget: Context within budget, no compression needed

prompt_construction.title: Prompt Construction
prompt_construction.assembly_step1_desc: Load base prompt template for current scenario from template.yaml (role definition + output format rules)
prompt_construction.assembly_step2_desc: Fill retrieved terminologies and SQL examples from Step 2 into {terminologies} and {data_training} placeholders
prompt_construction.assembly_step3_desc: Match custom prompts for current scenario from knowledge base, wrap with scene-specific tag and inject into {custom_prompt} placeholder
prompt_construction.assembly_step3_none: No matching custom prompts for current scenario
prompt_construction.assembly_step4_desc: Inject user question, data fields, query results and other dynamic content to generate final prompt
prompt_construction.part_instruction_detail: Role + Rules + Process + Examples + Output format
prompt_construction.hint_analysis_located: Located data analysis prompt injection section
prompt_construction.hint_prediction_located: Located data prediction prompt injection section
prompt_construction.hint_sql_located: Located SQL generation prompt injection section
prompt_construction.sql_example_hint_old_record: SQL example names require a new conversation to display (old records lack this data)
prompt_construction.custom_prompt_no_trigger_hint: Rules exist in the prompt library but the current datasource does not match. Check datasource settings in prompt management.
prompt_construction.schema_expand_hint: Database table structure definition (M-Schema format), including table names, field names, field types, and comments
prompt_construction.term_hint_old_record: Terminology names require a new conversation to display (old records lack this data)
prompt_construction.dialogue_context_hint: Multi-turn dialogue context injected, including conversation turns, active entities, and context references
prompt_construction.doc_chunks_expand_hint: PDF document chunks injected into system prompt via <document-knowledge> tags, LLM uses these chunks for document QA
prompt_construction.data_sample_expand_hint: Sample data queried from data source tables (up to 5 rows per table), injected via <data-sample> tags for data summarization
